title: 建造中的船体部件在保存加载后消失
description: 建造中的船体部件在保存加载后消失
evidence: The game still annoys with dissapearing hull parts (floors, walls) when you try to contruct them no one item after another (EXAMPLE: you move a wall, place it somewhere and then in the mid of work just go to do something else, if you save-load, it will dissapear, unless you will build this wall to 100% complete)

evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏仍然会因为船体部件（地板、墙壁）消失而让人恼火，当你试图一个接一个地建造它们时（例如：你移动一堵墙，把它放在某个地方，然后在工作途中去做别的事情，如果你存档再读档，它就会消失，除非你把这堵墙建到100%完成）
